candidates.description: This feature vector activates on sub-word tokens containing Hindi Devanagari script characters and Hindi text fragments.
This vector activates strongly on specific Devanagari script characters and common Hindi text fragments.
This feature vector activates on subword tokens and fragments predominantly found in Hindi script.
This vector represents characters or subword tokens from the Devanagari script used for writing Hindi and other Indian languages.
These tokens represent fragmented subword units and characters from Hindi script alongside miscellaneous artifacts.
This feature activates on the Hindi vowel sign 'ī' and its various contextual typographic combinations.
This vector activates for various vowel and consonant characters from different scripts, particularly Indic and Latin alphabets.
These tokens primarily represent Hindi Devanagari vowel signs, consonant-vowel conjuncts, and text encoding artifacts.
This vector activates for the Devanagari letter 'ध' (dha) and its various vowel and consonant conjunct forms.
This feature vector activates on Hindi verbs ending in the habitual suffix '-tā' (-त).
